text: Implemented ProjectedPatchOptimizer.scala and ProjectedPatchOptimizerSuite.scala. JVM and Scala.js Flashalign suites each passed 44/44 under strict Scala 3.7.4 compilation. Exact two-parameter quadratic plus nonzero prior gradient converged to (6.5/3, -5/7) within 2e-7. A non-diagonal physical metric forced RMS clipping at 0.25; stored prediction matched b' step - 0.5 step' H step to 2e-14, differed materially from a damping-inclusive prediction, and actual/predicted ratio was 1 within 2e-13. Three early-rejected trials made one data/prior linearization and preserved the nonidentity initial checkpoint with explicit TrialAttemptLimit. Separate tests produced RankDeficient(1,2), DampingLimited with zero trial evaluations, and NonFiniteSolve from finite-input overflow. A changed selection objective ID failed explicitly. The optimizer records bounded attempt traces, solve/trial/checkpoint counters, exact realized-step checks, physical maximum displacement and workspace ownership. Ownership passed at 1176 public names/64 canonical owners; PRD/build graph passed 148 IDs/27 nodes/94 edges; new-file whitespace checks were clean. Provider pins remain the B01-qualified hashes.
